svg.aria-label: wireframe schematic — the app’s own layout, drawn frame by frame: the given, then each beat. given a run whose recording holds several checked values; beat 1: you open the requirement's proof → one frame per checked value shows in order, cut from the recording at the instant it fired, each carrying its burned-in callout and got-vs-expected — a failing value red; beat 2: a run captured no recording → no strip shows at all — never a separately captured picture
